# Register SWAP and structural transposition first sources

The experiment starts from the existing two-Bit public operations, the
`take_bit` and `put_bit` contracts, and the static `qfor` owner rules. The two
first sources are ordinary local definitions. The CLI and checker hashes
come from the development branch before moving the definitions into std.
The observed hierarchy success reports producer consistency and the Raw
success reports native validity and source-step checking. Neither output
reports independent Meaning verification. The later Rust regression supplies
an independent whole-operator permutation and separately inspects actual
wire maps and gate work. The retained commands are inert history.
